class Solution:
    def countGoodRotations(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        half = n // 2
        total_sum = sum(nums)
        prefix_sum = 0
        count = 0

        for i in range(n):
            prefix_sum += nums[i]
            current_sum_first = prefix_sum - (total_sum - prefix_sum - nums[i])
            current_sum_second = total_sum - current_sum_first
            if current_sum_first > current_sum_second:
                count += 1
            prefix_sum -= nums[(i + half) % n]

        return count
